  "fixed_xml": "<ITEM><PUBLISHER>Die Cramerischen Herren Erben und Gebrüder Philibert</PUBLISHER>, Buchführere in <PLACE>Genff</PLACE>, proponiren dem Publico Subscriptions-Weis, eine neue Edition von <BIBL><AUTHOR>M. T. Ciceronis</AUTHOR> <TITLE>Operibus</TITLE>, cum Delectu Commentariorum à <AUTHOR>Josepho d'Olivet</AUTHOR>, in schön Pappier mit neuer Schrifft, von St. Augustini Text und Garamondi Noten; in conformität der Pariser Edition sehr correct heraus zugeben, und versprechen solches von allen darinn sich befindlichen Fehleren zu reinigen &c. das gantze Werck, welches in <FORMAT>4to</FORMAT> <VOLUME>9. Volumina</VOLUME> haltet, solle die Herren Praenumeranten nicht mehr als <PRIZE>67 Livres Frantzösische Valuta</PRIZE> oder <PRIZE>40. Francken Genffer-Geld</PRIZE> kosten &c. das weitere kan aus dem Project und Aviso bey <NAME>Herrn Onoffrio Hoffmann</NAME> allhier ersehen werden.</BIBL></ITEM>",
  "number_of_fixes": 14,
  "explanation": "1) Structural error: <PRIZE>67 Livres ...</PRICE> had a mismatched closing tag; changed to </PRIZE> to match the opening tag and the second price element (well-formedness fix). 2-3) The two occurrences of the abbreviation '&c.' (garbled as 'Íùõc.') were restored and escaped as '&c.', since a bare ampersand is illegal in XML. 4-10) Repaired seven mojibake sequences (Mac-Roman misreading of UTF-8): Gebrüder, Buchführere, à, schön, conformität, Frantzösische, and '4tò' -> '4to' (quarto). 11-12) Minor OCR/typography repairs in the text: 'PublicoSubscriptions-Weis' -> 'Publico Subscriptions-Weis' and 'M. T.Ciccronis' -> 'M. T. Ciceronis' (Cicero); also 'dOlivet' -> 'd'Olivet' (the editor Joseph d'Olivet). 13-14) Added semantically sensible markup consistent with the existing tag set: <PUBLISHER> for the Geneva booksellers (Cramer heirs and Philibert brothers), <PLACE> for Genff (Geneva), and <NAME> for the local agent Onoffrio Hoffmann. The <BIBL> element enclosing the format, volume and price information was left in place, as these details pertain to the advertised edition."
}
